name: Tatnai
overview: Tatnai was a Persian governor overseeing the region on this side of the river, as recorded in Ezra 5 and 6. He played a key role in questioning the authority behind the rebuilding of the temple and walls in Jerusalem, demonstrating the Persian administration's oversight of the Jewish restoration efforts. Tatnai also communicated with King Darius, sending letters that confirm the official nature of the inquiries and the subsequent royal commands. His actions show the providential preservation and legal protection of God's people during their return and rebuilding under foreign rule.
